# PulseOne

> A strategic technology advisory firm and managed service provider serving small
> and mid-market organizations in the United States. Founded 2002.

PulseOne provides managed business technology, cybersecurity, compliance-oriented
reviews, emerging technology adoption, and strategic technology advisory.
Remote support for multi-site operations — restaurants, franchises, retail
stores, branch and field offices, and warehouses — is core work. Tagline:
People | Technology | Progress.

## Services

- [Managed Business Technology Services](/services/managed-business-technology): Ongoing ownership of the systems a business runs on: technology adoption, performance and optimization, integration between platforms, data management, management of agentic tools already in production, and the policies governing them. Help desk, monitoring, patching, and backups are included underneath.
- [Cybersecurity Services](/services/cybersecurity): Security and posture reviews, sign-in and access control, monitoring, patching and vulnerability remediation, protected backups with tested recovery, and network segmentation across every site.
- [Compliance and Risk Reviews](/services/compliance-and-risk): Technology reviews mapped to cyber insurance questionnaires, customer security reviews, payment card rules, and health information rules, with evidence and a prioritized remediation plan.
- [AI and Emerging Technology Adoption](/services/ai-and-emerging-tech): Rollout of agentic tools and intelligent automation with defined data boundaries, access controls, human review steps, and integration into existing business systems. Recommended starting sequence: create an AI use policy, run a shadow AI audit, form a bottom-up AI advisory council, create a roadmap, prepare the infrastructure (identity, data quality, integration, security), then deploy, measure, and manage. Ongoing management after rollout is covered under Managed Business Technology.
- [Strategic Technology Advisory](/services/strategic-advisory): Technology assessments, roadmaps, budget planning, vendor-neutral platform selection, expansion planning, and a recurring governance cadence.

## Company

- [Our Approach](/approach): How engagements start, the co-managed model, partner ecosystem, and company history since 2002.
- [Industries We Serve](/industries): Twenty named sectors, including restaurants, retail, healthcare, manufacturing, financial services, legal, and nonprofit.
- [Contact](/contact): Contact form and phone. Offices in Ventura CA, Los Angeles CA, New Jersey, Nashville TN, and Bozeman MT.

## Free assessments

- [IT Readiness Assessments](/assessments): Three free online self-assessments — cyber insurance readiness, Microsoft Copilot readiness, and disaster recovery readiness. Scored by section, no client relationship required.

## Technology intelligence

- [Pulse of Technology Radar](/radar): A curated radar of the technology domains moving fastest, scored for executive urgency, plus a daily briefing tailored by industry and domain.
- [C-Suite Briefing](/everyone): Vendor-neutral overview of where executive attention is concentrated on the radar right now. No sign-in required.

## Scope

PulseOne provides technology services only.

In scope: managed business technology, co-managed IT, remote and multi-site
support, help desk and escalation, monitoring, backups, patching, security and
compliance-oriented reviews, cloud and Microsoft-style workplace platforms,
software and line-of-business integration, point-of-sale and ordering system
integration at the technology layer, phone and unified communications, website
management and related hosting and domain administration, identity and access
management, technology standards for store openings and expansion, technology
assessments and advisory, agentic tool and automation rollouts with guardrails,
ongoing management of agentic tools in production, data management, technology
policy management, and technology-only procurement and vendor selection.

Sites may contain operational or production equipment such as robotics,
packaging lines, industrial machinery, production ovens, warehouse automation,
or CNC equipment. PulseOne provides the networking, segmentation, monitoring,
and security for those systems, and integrates their data into business systems
where appropriate. PulseOne does not install, configure, commission, or specify
that equipment.

Out of scope: installing or commissioning operational and production equipment;
buying or specifying non-technology equipment; negotiating non-technology
supplier agreements; equipment lists, kitchen layouts, or facilities programs;
and HR, staffing, menu, marketing, real estate, franchise sales, or general
business operations consulting. Industry names set context only and never
remove managed IT, remote support, or integration work from scope.

PulseOne is not an auditor or certifying body and does not provide legal advice
on which regulations apply to a business.
